root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CustomerLocationTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.CustomerLocationTbl ( ContactID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_CustomerLocationTbl PRIMARY KEY, Latitude DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL, Longitude DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL, Geohash VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, MapAreaID INT NULL, GeocodedAddress NVARCHAR(500) NULL, SourceAddress NVARCHAR(500) NULL, LocationStatus VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CustomerLocation_Status DEFAULT ('APPROXIMATE'), Source VARCHAR(20) NULL, Confidence DECIMAL(4,3) NULL, CreatedDate DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CustomerLocation_Created DEFAULT (GETDATE()), UpdatedDate DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CustomerLocation_Updated DEFAULT (GETDATE()), UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(128) NULL ); CREATE INDEX IX_CustomerLocation_Geohash ON dbo.CustomerLocationTbl (Geohash); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.GeoApiUsageTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.GeoApiUsageTbl ( UsageDate DATE NOT NULL, Service VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, Calls INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GeoApiUsage_Calls DEFAULT (0), CONSTRAINT PK_GeoApiUsageTbl PRIMARY KEY (UsageDate, Service) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.GpsSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.GpsSettingsTbl ( SettingsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_GpsSettingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, GeocodeProvider VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Provider DEFAULT ('HeiGIT'), GeocodeApiKey NVARCHAR(500) NULL, GeocodeBaseUrl NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_BaseUrl DEFAULT (N'https://api.heigit.org'), GeocodeDailyLimit INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_DailyLimit DEFAULT (2500), GeocodePerMinute INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_PerMinute DEFAULT (90), MapTileUrl NVARCHAR(300) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_TileUrl DEFAULT (N'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png'), DepotAddress NVARCHAR(300) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_DepotAddress DEFAULT (N'Quaffee AT Buitenverwachting; Klein Constantia Rd; Constantia; Cape Town'), DepotLatitude DECIMAL(9,6) NULL, DepotLongitude DECIMAL(9,6) NULL, TrackingEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Tracking DEFAULT (0), PingIntervalMinutes INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_PingInterval DEFAULT (10), TrackingWeekdaysOnly BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Weekdays DEFAULT (1), WorkHoursStart VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_WorkStart DEFAULT ('07:00'), WorkHoursEnd VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_WorkEnd DEFAULT ('18:00'), PingRetentionDays INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Retention DEFAULT (30), AverageSpeedKmh INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Speed DEFAULT (30), ServiceMinutes INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Service DEFAULT (5), FreshMinutes INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Fresh DEFAULT (15), StaleMinutes INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GpsSettings_Stale DEFAULT (30), UpdatedAt DATETIME NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(128) NULL ); INSERT INTO dbo.GpsSettingsTbl (SettingsID) VALUES (1); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl WHERE OptionText = N'Collected') BEGIN INSERT INTO dbo.MobileDeliveryOptionsTbl (Outcome, OptionText, NeedsName, SortOrder, IsEnabled) VALUES ('Delivered', N'Collected', 0, 25, 1); END
